verses.gurmukhi: ਅਨਭੈ ਭਵਨ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਦ੍ਵਾਰ ਚਾਰੋ ਬਸਿ ਚਾਰੋ ਕੁੰਟ ਰਾਜਤ ਰਾਜਾਨ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: anabhai bhavan prem bhagat mukat dhavaiaar chaaro bas chaaro ku(n)T raajat raajaan hai ||

en.bdb: The door of the True Guru is perpetual source of knowledge, a place where His slaves are ever involved in His loving worship and His loving maids are praying for salvation.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜਾਗ੍ਰਤ ਸ੍ਵਪਨ ਦਿਨ ਰੈਨ ਉਠਿ ਬੈਠਿ ਚਲਿ ਸਿਮਰਨ ਸ੍ਰਵਨ ਸੁਕ੍ਰਿਤ ਪਰਵਾਨ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaagrat savaipan dhin rain uTh baiTh chal simaran sravan sukirat paravaan hai ||

en.bdb: That human being is ever accepted at the door of the True Guru who utters and listens to His divine name awake, sleeping, sitting, standing or walking. This for him is the supreme task for him.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੋਈ ਜੋਈ ਆਵੈ ਸੋਈ ਭਾਵੈ ਪਾਵੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧ ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲ ਮਾਨੋ ਬਾਜਤ ਨੀਸਾਨ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: joiee joiee aavai soiee bhaavai paavai naam nidh bhagat vachhal maano baajat neesaan hai ||

en.bdb: All those who come to the door of the True Guru with devotion and love are accepted by the True Guru. He acquires the invaluable treasure of Name. It seems the proclamation of Him being the lover of the worshippers is being sounded on His door in the form of drum beating.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜਵਿਨ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਸਾਮ ਰਾਜ ਸੁਖ ਭੋਗਵਤ ਅਦਭੁਤ ਛਬਿ ਅਤਿ ਹੀ ਬਿਰਾਜਮਾਨ ਹੈ ॥੬੧੯॥
verses.translit_en: javin mukat saam raaj sukh bhogavat adhabhut chhab at hee biraajamaan hai ||619||

en.bdb: All those human beings who take refuge on the door of the king of kings, they enjoy the wondrous comforts of the treasure of Name and becomes liberated while alive. Such wondrous beauty of the court of the True Guru is becoming well adorned.  (619)
